briefs.hook_script: Before you spend $300 on a brand new alternator because your battery keeps dying overnight, do NOT touch a wrench. In 90% of cases we see in the shop, the alternator is actually fine—it's a hidden 50 milliamp parasitic drain from a stuck relay or telematics unit. In the next 8 minutes, I'll show you how to find the exact circuit with an eight-dollar multimeter.
